messages.text:
Hi, I am looking for this globe but to ship to Canada: 
Lisbon 10″ Blue Illuminated Desk – Replogle Globes

I don't see a "Lisbon 10″ Blue Illuminated Desk" globe in our current lineup, so I can't confirm details on that one — it may not be one we carry. We do ship anywhere in Canada, and shipping is free on orders of $99 or more.

If you're after a small illuminated blue desk globe, the Replogle Terenne 6" Desktop Globe - Illuminated Blue Ocean (the one you looked at) is a nice compact option, or if you'd like something closer to 10-12 inches, the Austin 12-inch Illuminated Blue Desktop Globe would fit that size and still glow when lit. What size are you hoping for?
I didn't see the Austin 12", I'll have a look.  The Lisbon 10" is on the Replogle US site

Ah, good catch on my part to mention it, but I should flag — the Austin 12-inch Illuminated Blue Desktop Globe is actually sold out right now. My apologies for pointing you to it.

For a similar look — a blue illuminated globe for the desk — I'd suggest the Odessa 12-inch Antique Ocean Illuminated Desk Globe or, if you want blue ocean specifically, the Replogle Odessa 12" Illuminated Desk Globe - Blue Ocean & Raised Relief, both around 12 inches and currently in stock. Also worth noting: the Lisbon you saw is on the US Replogle site, so it's a different store from ours — we only carry what's listed on replogleglobes.ca. Would blue ocean or a warmer antique tone suit your space better?

You're welcome! You'll find it under "Replogle Odessa 12" Illuminated Desk Globe - Blue Ocean & Raised Relief" — just search that name on the site and you can add it straight to your cart. Out of curiosity, what drew you to a blue illuminated one over the antique look?
any other illuminated ones you can recommend?

If you like the illuminated blue ocean look, the National Geographic Bartlett 12" Illuminated Blue Ocean Desk Globe is a great next step up — same glowing dual-map effect as the Odessa, with National Geographic's detailed cartography. If you'd rather stick with Replogle's own design but want a bit more size and presence, the National Geographic Nicollet 16" Illuminated Desk Globe is a larger blue ocean option that really lights up a room. Which feels closer to what you're picturing?
I really like the blue lisbon - it is for a kid.  anything in the 10" size?

For a 10-inch size made with kids in mind, the Replogle Globes 10" Illuminated Globe 4 Kids - Augmented Reality Feature is a great fit — it lights up like the Lisbon you liked, and the augmented reality feature makes it fun and interactive for a child exploring the globe. You'll find it under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart. Is this globe for your own child, or a gift?
